description:
A private, permission-aware mobile client for your TrueNAS server

Keel is a mobile client for TrueNAS Community Edition (SCALE). Check your server's health, manage apps, run backups and handle alerts from your phone, without exposing anything to the internet.

What it does

  • Live dashboard with CPU, memory, network and pool health
  • Apps: live usage, start, stop, redeploy, upgrade with changelog, roll back, edit configuration, container logs
  • Storage: pools, datasets, snapshots, scrubs, and snapshot, replication and cloud sync tasks
  • Alerts with optional background notifications
  • Services, updates, reporting graphs, boot environments, network and audit log
  • VMs, LXC containers, SMB and NFS shares, users
  • Several servers, with a home screen widget for alert counts

Want to look around first? Tap "Try a demo server" to explore every screen with sample data, no server needed.

Built for security

  • Signs in with SCRAM-SHA-512, so your API key never crosses the network
  • Stores only derived keys, encrypted in the Android Keystore behind your fingerprint or PIN
  • Pins self-signed certificates and refuses public addresses unless you opt in
  • Only shows the actions your API key's roles allow, with stricter confirmation for riskier ones
  • No analytics, ads, crash reporting or Google services. It talks only to your server.

Keel is an independent open source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by TrueNAS or iXsystems. TrueNAS is a registered trademark of iXsystems, Inc.
